name: Omnipress
author: omnipressteam

sections.description:
Power-up the Gutenberg editor with advanced patterns and blocks to help you build websites quickly! Omnipress is the first truly Gutenberg Full Site Editing (FSE) plugin designed to make website building effortless.

  • Pick pre-built WordPress Patterns, Demos, or Blocks from Omnipress to streamline the website-building process.
  • Enjoy easy-to-use settings and customizations for intuitive visual styling.

Visit the Omnipress Patterns Library.

With Omnipress, we’ve simplified website building by providing unique and creative patterns for Gutenberg. Design your pages or posts without a single line of code.

Explore Omnipress Pre-Built Demos.
– Ready-to-use Full Website Demos for Gutenberg.
– Professionally designed starter sites built using Gutenberg, Omnipress Plugin, and Omnipress Themes.
– Import them in just a few clicks, tweak easily, and build websites in minutes!

Key Benefits:
– Pixel-perfect pre-built websites tailored for various niches such as agencies, businesses, blogs, news, eCommerce, and more.
– All demos and patterns are compatible with any theme.

Discover instant website setup with one click! Try our live demo and unlock limitless creativity with FSE Block Themes.

Key Features

🗝️ Highlights:
– Full Site Editing (FSE): Build websites effortlessly using the Gutenberg editor.
– Pattern Library: Access a wide range of pre-built patterns.
– Demo Library: Utilize demos for various website types.
– Custom Blocks: Create advanced blocks with unique styling.
– WooCommerce Support: Build eCommerce sites seamlessly.
– Premium Blocks: Get advanced features with premium blocks.
– Responsive Design: Ensure your site looks great on any device.
– SEO Optimized: Built-in SEO tools for better visibility.
– Accessibility-Friendly: Make your site inclusive for all users.
– High Performance: Optimized for speed and efficiency.
– Support & Updates: Enjoy prompt support and regular updates.

Omnipress Blocks

Core Blocks

  • Column: A versatile block for creating multi-column layouts. – Showcase
  • Container: Wrap content in a customizable container. – Showcase
  • Google Maps: Embed Google Maps with custom options. – Showcase
  • Image: Insert and style images. – Showcase
  • Video: Embed videos from various sources. – Showcase
  • Paragraph: Add and format text content. – Showcase

Creative Blocks

  • Accordion: Create expandable accordion sections. – Showcase
  • Countdown: Display countdown timers. – Showcase
  • Mega Menu: Design complex navigation menus. – Showcase
  • Menu Item: Add items to navigation menus. – Showcase
  • Slide: Create individual slides for presentations. – Showcase
  • Slider: Build image and content sliders. – Showcase
  • Tab Labels: Manage tabbed content with custom labels. – Showcase
  • Tabs: Add tabbed sections to your content. – Showcase
  • Tabs Content: Define content for tab sections. – Showcase
  • Icon Box: Display icons with descriptive text. – Showcase
  • Post Grid: Arrange posts in a grid layout. – Showcase
  • Counter: Create counters for statistics or features. – Showcase

Simple Blocks

  • Button: Add customizable buttons. – Showcase
  • Custom CSS: Apply custom CSS to elements. – Showcase
  • Dual Button: Add pairs of buttons for actions. – Showcase
  • Heading: Insert and format headings. – Showcase
  • Icons: Display icon sets. – Showcase
  • Team: Showcase team members with profiles. – Showcase
  • Contact Form: Add contact forms to your site. – Showcase

Premium Blocks

  • Advanced Query Loop: Create advanced loops for custom queries. – Showcase
  • Query Template: Design custom query templates. – Showcase
  • Query Pagination: Add pagination to queries. – Showcase
  • Query Pagination Previous: Add previous page pagination control. – Showcase
  • Query Pagination Next: Add next page pagination control. – Showcase
  • Query Pagination Numbers: Display page numbers for pagination. – Showcase
  • Query No Results: Show a message when no results are found. – Showcase
  • Dynamic Field Query: Retrieve and display dynamic field data. – Showcase
  • Content Switcher: Switch between different content blocks. – Showcase

WooCommerce Blocks:
– Products Grid: Showcase products in a grid.
– Products Carousel: Showcase products in a grid.
– Products List: Showcase products in a grid.
– Product Grid: Showcase products in a grid.

  • Product Categories Grid: Showcase products in a grid.
  • Product Categories List: Showcase products in a grid.
  • Product Categories Carousel: Showcase products in a grid.

Premium Blocks:
– Advanced Query Loop: Create complex custom queries.
– Dynamic Field Query: Fetch and display dynamic field data.
– Dynamic Field Query: Query custom taxonomies.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv3 license. See LICENSE for details.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:
1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
2. Search for “Omnipress” and click Install Now.
3. Activate the plugin.

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin.
2. Extract and upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
3. Go to Plugins in the admin dashboard and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Q: Do you provide support for the free version?

Yes! Get help in our support forum.

Q: Are there any getting-started guides?

Yes! Check out our YouTube video tutorials.

Q: What are the minimum server requirements?

  • WordPress: 5.8 or later.
  • PHP: 7.4 or later.
  • MySQL: 5.6 or later.
sections.changelog:
Version 1.5.1

Enhancements & Fixes:
Resolved an issue where global components did not function as expected in the editor.
Fixed a problem causing blocks to appear unstyled on the initial page render after demo imports.
Added a warning prompt before major plugin updates to ensure a smoother update process.
Fixed: Compatibility notice for WordPress 6.7 regarding the incorrect usage of _load_textdomain_just_in_time.

See complete changelog.
